LAST DAY FOR HEARING SUMMARY MOTIONS IS DECEMBER 6. PLAINTIFFS WILL NOT STIPULATE THAT SUMMARY MOTIONS MAY BE HEARD ON 15 DAYS NOTICE WITHOUT AN ADDITIONAL TWO DAYS FOR E-SERVICE. THE LAST DAY TO HEAR SUMMARY MOTIONS REMAINS DECEMBER 6, WITH OPPOSITIONS DUE FIVE COURT DAYS BEFORE THE HEARING AND REPLIES DUE TWO COURT DAYS BEFORE THE HEARING. PLAINTIFFS TO MAKE A SETTLEMENT DEMAND ON ALL DEFENDANTS NO LATER THAN 11/19/12. SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE IN ROOM 603 AT 1:30PM ON 12/06/12. FACT DISCOVERY CUT-OFF DATE IS 11/30/12. EXPERT DISCOVERY CUT-OFF DATE IS 12/14/12. NO LATER THAN 09/21/12, PLAINTIFFS MUST PROVIDE A STATEMENT STATING, AS TO EACH DEFENDANT, THE NAME AND CONTACT INFORMATION OF EACH PERSON WITH KNOWLEDGE OF ANY FACTS SUPPORTING ANY OF PLAINTIFFS' CLAIMS. NO LATER THAN 09/21/12, DEFENDANTS MUST PROVIDE A STATEMENT STATING THE NAME AND CONTACT INFORMATION OF EACH PERSON WITH KNOWLEDGE OF ANY FACTS SUPPORTING ANY OF DEFENDANT'S AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSES. ANY PERSON NOT IDENTIFIED ON THE STATEMENTS WILL BE BARRED FROM TESTIFYING AT TRIAL OR PRESENTING A DECLARATION ON A SUMMARY MOTION ABSENT GOOD CAUSE SHOWN. THE PARTIES TO MEET AND CONFER REGARDING ANY OTHER SCHEDULING OR OTHER ISSUE WHICH ANY OF THEM WANT TO HAVE INCLUDED IN THE PREFERENCE ORDER. FURTHER CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE ON 11/20/12 AT 1:30PM. NO NEED FOR ANY PARTY TO FILE ANY CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE STATEMENT. PARTIES MAY APPEAR AT THE CONFERENCE BY TELEPHONE. THERE WILL BE A MANDATORY SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE WITH THE COURT PURSUANT TO SF LOCAL RULES OF COURT RULE 5 AND THE DATE OF THIS CONFERENCE WILL BE PROVIDED TO THE PARTIES BY THE COURT AT A LATER DATE. THE PARTIES SHALL COMPLY WITH LOCAL RULE 5.0. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: TERI L. JACKSON, REPORTER: PATRICIA RODRIGUEZ OF AIKEN WELCH, CSR #124

MINI MINUTES:
APPEARANCES:
Oren P. Noah of BRAYTON & PURCELL LLP (415-898-1555), appearing for plaintiffs / moving parties Benny Wilkins Sr., et al.

RULING:
No objections to the tentative ruling, the Court adopted its ruling as amended: Plaintiffs' motion for preference is granted per C.C.P. sections 36(a). No opposition filed. Trial is December 17, 2012 at 11:15am in Department 503. Last day for hearing summary motions is December 6. Plaintiffs will not stipulate that summary motions may be heard on 15 days notice without an additional two days for e-service. The last day to hear summary motions remains December 6, with oppositions due five court days before the hearing and replies due two court days before the hearing. Plaintiffs to make a settlement demand on all defendants no later than November 19, 2012. Settlement conference in room 603 at 1:30pm on December 6, 2012. Fact discovery cut-off date is November 30, 2012. Expert discovery cut-off date is December 14, 2012. No later than September 21, 2012, plaintiffs must provide a statement stating, as to each defendant, the name and contact information of each person with knowledge of any facts supporting any of plaintiffs' claims. No later than September 21, 2012, defendants must provide a statement stating the name and contact information of each person with knowledge of any facts supporting any of defendant's affirmative defenses. Any person not identified on the statements will be barred from testifying at trial or presenting a declaration on a summary motion absent good cause shown. The parties to meet and confer regarding any other scheduling or other issue which any of them want to have included in the preference order. Further case management conference on November 20, 2012 at 1:30pm. No need for any party to file any case management conference statement. Parties may appear at the conference by telephone. There will be a mandatory settlement conference with the court pursuant to San Francisco Local Rules of Court Rule 5 and the date of this conference will be provided to the parties by the court at a later date. The parties shall comply with Local Rule 5.0. Order signed in open court. Judge: Teri L. Jackson, Reporter: Patricia Rodriguez of AIKEN WELCH, CSR #12436 (503/TLJ)
